cherenkov_quartz.name: Cherenkov Quartz
cherenkov_quartz.current_text: Glows with the blue light of particles outrunning light in a medium.
cherenkov_quartz.research: Cosmogenesis - False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.

degenerate_matter_chunk.name: Degenerate Matter Chunk
degenerate_matter_chunk.current_text: Electron-degenerate matter from a dead star's core. Absurdly heavy.
degenerate_matter_chunk.research: Cosmogenesis - False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.

neutronium_plate.name: Neutronium Plate
neutronium_plate.current_text: Rolled to a thickness of a few femtometres.

void_lattice_shard.name: Void Lattice Shard
void_lattice_shard.current_text: A fragment of the scaffolding between branes.

exotic_matter_crystal.name: Exotic Matter Crystal
exotic_matter_crystal.current_text: Negative energy density. It tries to fall upward.
exotic_matter_crystal.research: Cosmogenesis - False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.

qubit.name: Qubit
qubit.current_text: |0> and |1> at once, until you look.
qubit.research: Quantum Entanglement - Spooky action at a distance, put to work. Unlocks qubits and the Quantum Entangler.

entangled_photon_pair.name: Entangled Photon Pair
entangled_photon_pair.current_text: Measure one and the other already knows.
entangled_photon_pair.research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

quantum_dot.name: Quantum Dot
quantum_dot.current_text: An artificial atom; its colour is set by its size.
quantum_dot.research: The Casimir Effect - Two plates in a vacuum attract: empty space is full of energy. Unlocks the Casimir Press and Zero-Point Extractor.

superposition_crystal.name: Superposition Crystal
superposition_crystal.current_text: Exists in several lattice configurations simultaneously.
superposition_crystal.research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

quantum_processor.name: Quantum Processor
quantum_processor.current_text: A fault-tolerant array of logical qubits.
quantum_processor.research: Matrioshka Brain - Wrap a star in nested shells of computronium and let it think.

casimir_plate.name: Casimir Plate
casimir_plate.current_text: Two plates nanometres apart. The vacuum between them pushes.
casimir_plate.research: The Casimir Effect - Two plates in a vacuum attract: empty space is full of energy. Unlocks the Casimir Press and Zero-Point Extractor.

metamaterial_sheet.name: Metamaterial Sheet
metamaterial_sheet.current_text: Negative refractive index. Light bends the wrong way.
metamaterial_sheet.research: Metamaterials - Engineered structures with a negative refractive index.

topological_insulator.name: Topological Insulator
topological_insulator.current_text: Insulating bulk, conducting surface - protected by topology.
topological_insulator.research: Topological Matter - Phases of matter protected by topology rather than symmetry.

superconducting_coil.name: Superconducting Coil
superconducting_coil.current_text: Zero resistance. The current never stops.
superconducting_coil.research: Cryogenics - Near absolute zero, matter forgets it is many particles. Superfluids and Bose-Einstein condensates.

higgs_field_capacitor.name: Higgs Field Capacitor
higgs_field_capacitor.current_text: Stores a local excitation of the Higgs field. Handles mass.
higgs_field_capacitor.research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

tachyon_crystal.name: Tachyon Crystal
tachyon_crystal.research: Tachyonics - Hypothetical faster-than-light particles. Their imaginary mass makes them slow down as they gain energy.

chronon_capacitor.name: Chronon Capacitor
chronon_capacitor.current_text: Holds quanta of time. Handle before use.
chronon_capacitor.research: Chronodynamics - If time is quantised, its quanta can be stored.

antimatter_pellet.name: Antimatter Pellet
antimatter_pellet.current_text: Held in a Penning trap. Do not let it touch anything.
antimatter_pellet.research: Antimatter Containment - Pair production and Penning traps.

strange_matter_pellet.name: Strange Matter Pellet
strange_matter_pellet.current_text: Up, down and strange quarks. Possibly contagious.
strange_matter_pellet.research: Thermodynamics of Information - Information is physical. A demon that knows which molecules are fast can sort them and reverse entropy.

magnetic_monopole.name: Magnetic Monopole
magnetic_monopole.current_text: A north pole with no south. Dirac would be pleased.
magnetic_monopole.research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

cosmic_string_segment.name: Cosmic String Segment
cosmic_string_segment.current_text: A one-dimensional defect from the early universe.
cosmic_string_segment.research: White Holes - The time-reverse of a black hole: a horizon nothing can enter.

dark_matter_lens.name: Dark Matter Lens
dark_matter_lens.research: The Dark Sector - Most of the universe's mass does not interact with light. Unlocks the Dark Matter Halo Collector.

calabi_yau_manifold.name: Calabi-Yau Manifold
calabi_yau_manifold.current_text: Six compact dimensions, folded small enough to hold.
calabi_yau_manifold.research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

planck_shard.name: Planck Shard
planck_shard.current_text: 1.6 x 10^-35 m. You cannot cut it smaller.
planck_shard.research: Thermodynamics of Information - Information is physical. A demon that knows which molecules are fast can sort them and reverse entropy.

hawking_emitter.name: Hawking Emitter
hawking_emitter.current_text: Channels the thermal glow of an evaporating horizon.
hawking_emitter.research: Singularity Physics - Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.

kugelblitz_seed.name: Kugelblitz Seed
kugelblitz_seed.current_text: Enough focused light to collapse on itself.
kugelblitz_seed.research: Singularity Physics - Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.

alcubierre_coil.name: Alcubierre Coil
alcubierre_coil.current_text: Contracts space ahead, expands it behind.
alcubierre_coil.research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

penrose_spindle.name: Penrose Spindle
penrose_spindle.current_text: Couples to a rotating horizon's ergosphere.

micro_singularity.name: Micro Singularity
micro_singularity.current_text: A black hole the mass of a mountain, smaller than an atom.
micro_singularity.research: Singularity Physics - Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.

white_hole_fragment.name: White Hole Fragment
white_hole_fragment.current_text: A time-reversed horizon. Nothing can enter.
white_hole_fragment.research: Inside a Black Hole - What is past the horizon - and, through an Einstein-Rosen bridge, what is past the white hole's. Unlocks the Horizon Diver and the Geodesic Anchor.

tesseract_core.name: Tesseract Core
tesseract_core.current_text: A hypercube's 3D shadow, rotating through a direction you cannot point to.
tesseract_core.research: Causality Violation - Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

spectral_analyzer.name: Spectral Analyzer
spectral_analyzer.current_text: Right-click phenomena, blocks or creatures to gain Insight.

brane_shifter.name: Brane Shifter
brane_shifter.current_text: Slip sideways out of this brane and into the Bulk.

quantum_string.name: Quantum String
quantum_string.current_text: A one-dimensional vibrating string. Its mode of vibration decides which particle it is.
quantum_string.research: String Theory - Every particle is a vibrating string. Unlocks the String Resonance Loom.

m_brane.name: M-Brane
m_brane.current_text: A two-dimensional membrane of M-theory. Whole universes can live on one.
m_brane.research: M-Theory - Strings are the edges of membranes in eleven dimensions.

graviton_crystal.name: Graviton Crystal
graviton_crystal.current_text: Quantised gravity, frozen into a lattice. Feels heavier than it is.
graviton_crystal.research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

spin_foam_lattice.name: Spin Foam Lattice
spin_foam_lattice.current_text: Loop quantum gravity: spacetime itself, woven from discrete quanta of area.
spin_foam_lattice.research: Quantum Gravity - Gravitons and spin foam: spacetime made of quanta. Unlocks the Graviton Condenser.

multiverse_shard.name: Multiverse Shard
multiverse_shard.current_text: Matter from a universe with slightly different constants. Its colour will not settle.
multiverse_shard.research: Traversable Wormholes - Black and white holes joined at the throat, propped open with negative mass.

rift_anchor.name: Rift Anchor
rift_anchor.current_text: Pins a tear between universes open long enough to reach through.
rift_anchor.research: The Multiverse - Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.

universe_seed.name: Universe Seed
universe_seed.current_text: A grain of false vacuum primed to inflate into a cosmos.
universe_seed.research: Cosmogenesis - False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.

pocket_universe.name: Pocket Universe
pocket_universe.current_text: An entire cosmos, folded into a bubble you can hold. Please do not drop it.
pocket_universe.research: Causality Violation - Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

heat_death_remnant.name: Heat Death Remnant
heat_death_remnant.current_text: All that is left of a universe at maximum entropy. Cold, even and perfectly still.
heat_death_remnant.research: Cosmogenesis - False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.

photonic_neuron.name: Photonic Neuron
photonic_neuron.current_text: A neuron that thinks at the speed of light.
photonic_neuron.research: Artificial Intelligence - Photonic neural networks and narrow AI. Unlocks the Neural Synthesizer.

neural_lattice.name: Neural Lattice
neural_lattice.current_text: Billions of photonic neurons in a self-organising mesh.
neural_lattice.research: Artificial Intelligence - Photonic neural networks and narrow AI. Unlocks the Neural Synthesizer.

narrow_ai_core.name: Narrow AI Core
narrow_ai_core.current_text: Superhuman at one thing; useless at everything else.
narrow_ai_core.research: Artificial Intelligence - Photonic neural networks and narrow AI. Unlocks the Neural Synthesizer.

general_ai_core.name: General AI Core
general_ai_core.current_text: An artificial general intelligence. It asks good questions.
general_ai_core.research: Artificial General Intelligence - A mind that can learn anything.

superintelligence_core.name: Superintelligence Core
superintelligence_core.current_text: It has already read this tooltip. And the next one.
superintelligence_core.research: Matrioshka Brain - Wrap a star in nested shells of computronium and let it think.

computronium_ingot.name: Computronium Ingot
computronium_ingot.current_text: Matter arranged for the maximum possible computation per gram.

solar_statite.name: Solar Statite
solar_statite.current_text: A light sail balanced between gravity and radiation pressure.
solar_statite.research: Dyson Swarm - Millions of statites harvesting starlight.

dyson_swarm_satellite.name: Dyson Swarm Satellite
dyson_swarm_satellite.current_text: One of millions. Feed them to a Dyson Array.
dyson_swarm_satellite.research: Dyson Swarm - Millions of statites harvesting starlight.

dyson_shell_segment.name: Dyson Shell Segment
dyson_shell_segment.current_text: A curved plate of a star-enclosing shell. 64 of them close the sphere.
dyson_shell_segment.research: Dyson Sphere - Close the swarm into a shell and capture a star's entire output.

stellar_core.name: Stellar Core
stellar_core.current_text: A captive star the size of a fist, ignited by a white hole.
stellar_core.research: Plasma Metallurgy - Alloys forged in stellar plasma: Chronosteel and Exotic Solder. Unlocks the Stellar Plasma Crucible.

negentropy_cell.name: Negentropy Cell
negentropy_cell.current_text: Order, bottled. Entropy flows backwards inside.
negentropy_cell.research: Thermodynamics of Information - Information is physical. A demon that knows which molecules are fast can sort them and reverse entropy.

maxwell_demon_chip.name: Maxwell's Demon Chip
maxwell_demon_chip.current_text: A tiny intelligence that opens a door for fast molecules only. Thermodynamics objects.
maxwell_demon_chip.research: Thermodynamics of Information - Information is physical. A demon that knows which molecules are fast can sort them and reverse entropy.

holographic_matrix.name: Holographic Matrix
holographic_matrix.current_text: A 3D object stored entirely on its 2D boundary.
holographic_matrix.research: The Holographic Principle - Everything inside a volume is encoded on its boundary - black holes included.

bekenstein_crystal.name: Bekenstein Crystal
bekenstein_crystal.current_text: Holds the maximum information a region of space can contain.
bekenstein_crystal.research: The Holographic Principle - Everything inside a volume is encoded on its boundary - black holes included.

source_code_fragment.name: Source Code Fragment
source_code_fragment.current_text: A few lines of the program that runs the universe. Mostly comments.
source_code_fragment.research: The Simulation Hypothesis - If reality is computed, it can be decompiled - and edited.

reality_anchor.name: Reality Anchor
reality_anchor.current_text: Keeps a patch of reality from being edited.
reality_anchor.research: The Simulation Hypothesis - If reality is computed, it can be decompiled - and edited.

omega_point.name: Omega Point
omega_point.current_text: The final state of all computation. It already knows how this ends.
omega_point.research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

nanite_swarm.name: Nanite Swarm
nanite_swarm.current_text: A billion machines the size of viruses. Hungry.
nanite_swarm.research: Molecular Nanotechnology - Assemblers that build anything atom by atom - including copies of themselves.

programmable_matter.name: Programmable Matter
programmable_matter.current_text: Matter that changes its own shape and properties on command.
programmable_matter.research: Molecular Nanotechnology - Assemblers that build anything atom by atom - including copies of themselves.

claytronic_catom.name: Claytronic Catom
claytronic_catom.current_text: One cell of a substance that can become anything.
claytronic_catom.research: Molecular Nanotechnology - Assemblers that build anything atom by atom - including copies of themselves.

von_neumann_probe.name: Von Neumann Probe
von_neumann_probe.current_text: Builds copies of itself from whatever it finds. Put one in a Dyson Array.
von_neumann_probe.research: Dyson Swarm - Millions of statites harvesting starlight.

massless_alloy.name: Massless Alloy
massless_alloy.current_text: The Higgs field has been told to ignore it.
massless_alloy.research: Mass Manipulation - Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.

negative_mass_ingot.name: Negative Mass Ingot
negative_mass_ingot.current_text: Push it and it comes toward you.
negative_mass_ingot.research: Mass Manipulation - Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.

inertia_damper.name: Inertia Damper
inertia_damper.current_text: Cancels momentum locally. Standard issue on every starship.
inertia_damper.research: Mass Manipulation - Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.

metallic_hydrogen_ingot.name: Metallic Hydrogen Ingot
metallic_hydrogen_ingot.current_text: Hydrogen crushed until it conducts like a metal. Metastable, probably.
metallic_hydrogen_ingot.research: Compact Stars - Neutron stars, magnetars, pulsars and quark stars - the densest objects short of a singularity.

sterile_neutrino.name: Sterile Neutrino
sterile_neutrino.current_text: Interacts with nothing except gravity. Very hard to keep hold of.
sterile_neutrino.research: Neutrino Physics - Ghost particles, trillions of which pass through you every second.

quark_star_core.name: Quark Star Core
quark_star_core.current_text: The heart of a star too dense even for neutrons.
quark_star_core.research: Compact Stars - Neutron stars, magnetars, pulsars and quark stars - the densest objects short of a singularity.

magnetar_shard.name: Magnetar Shard
magnetar_shard.current_text: Its magnetic field would wipe a credit card from the Moon.
magnetar_shard.research: Traversable Wormholes - Black and white holes joined at the throat, propped open with negative mass.

pulsar_timing_crystal.name: Pulsar Timing Crystal
pulsar_timing_crystal.current_text: Ticks with the precision of a millisecond pulsar.
pulsar_timing_crystal.research: Compact Stars - Neutron stars, magnetars, pulsars and quark stars - the densest objects short of a singularity.

dilithium_crystal.name: Dilithium Crystal
dilithium_crystal.current_text: Porous to antimatter. It regulates annihilation reactions.

annihilation_core.name: Annihilation Core
annihilation_core.current_text: A controlled matter-antimatter reaction in a box.
annihilation_core.research: Annihilation Power - Matter plus antimatter equals pure energy. Dilithium keeps it from equalling a crater.

wormhole_throat.name: Wormhole Throat
wormhole_throat.current_text: The narrowest point of an Einstein-Rosen bridge, held open with exotic matter.
wormhole_throat.research: Causality Violation - Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

closed_timelike_curve.name: Closed Timelike Curve
closed_timelike_curve.current_text: A path through spacetime that ends where - and when - it started.
closed_timelike_curve.research: Causality Violation - Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

paradox_residue.name: Paradox Residue
paradox_residue.current_text: What is left after a contradiction resolves itself.
paradox_residue.research: The Axiomatic Breach - Break every law of physics and mathematics at once, and step through the hole. Unlocks the Axiomatic Breach Engine and the Axiom Key.

bootstrap_artifact.name: Bootstrap Artifact
bootstrap_artifact.current_text: Nobody made it. It was always handed back from the future.
bootstrap_artifact.research: Causality Violation - Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

cosmological_constant.name: Cosmological Constant
cosmological_constant.current_text: Lambda: the energy of empty space that pushes the universe apart.
cosmological_constant.research: Dark Energy - The energy of empty space itself, pushing galaxies apart.

psionic_crystal.name: Psionic Crystal
psionic_crystal.research: Psionics - Thought, crystallised. A science that should not exist.

thought_matrix.name: Thought Matrix
thought_matrix.current_text: A thought, frozen in a lattice so it can be copied.
thought_matrix.research: Psionics - Thought, crystallised. A science that should not exist.

boltzmann_brain.name: Boltzmann Brain
boltzmann_brain.current_text: A mind that fluctuated into existence from random noise. It is very confused.
boltzmann_brain.research: Psionics - Thought, crystallised. A science that should not exist.

aleph_null_shard.name: Aleph-Null Shard
aleph_null_shard.current_text: The size of the natural numbers, made solid. Counting its facets never ends.
aleph_null_shard.research: Transfinite Mathematics - Cantor proved that some infinities are bigger than others. Build them. Unlocks the Cantor Diagonalizer.

godel_sentence.name: Godel Sentence
godel_sentence.current_text: "This statement cannot be proven." It is true, and no system can prove it.
godel_sentence.research: Incompleteness - Any system strong enough to describe arithmetic contains truths it can never prove - reality included.

banach_tarski_sphere.name: Banach-Tarski Sphere
banach_tarski_sphere.current_text: Cut it into five non-measurable pieces, reassemble them, and you have two spheres.
banach_tarski_sphere.research: Paradox Engineering - Russell sets and Banach-Tarski spheres: building with contradictions.

russell_paradox_set.name: Russell Paradox Set
russell_paradox_set.current_text: The set of all sets that do not contain themselves. Does it contain itself?
russell_paradox_set.research: Paradox Engineering - Russell sets and Banach-Tarski spheres: building with contradictions.

absolute_infinity.name: Absolute Infinity
absolute_infinity.current_text: Larger than every infinity. It cannot be conceived - and yet here it is.
absolute_infinity.research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

axiom_fragment.name: Axiom Fragment
axiom_fragment.current_text: A shard of a foundational rule. Mathematics is built on these; so is reality.
axiom_fragment.research: Hyperdimensional Reality - The space outside every universe, where universes grow on a tree and laws are born from an ocean.

axiom_key.name: Axiom Key
axiom_key.current_text: Opens the breach to the space where laws are born. Use it to travel there and back.
axiom_key.research: The Axiomatic Breach - Break every law of physics and mathematics at once, and step through the hole. Unlocks the Axiomatic Breach Engine and the Axiom Key.

arbor_heartwood_sample.name: Arbor Heartwood Sample
arbor_heartwood_sample.current_text: Wood from the World Tree. It is warm, cold, heavy and weightless, sometimes all at once.

bubble_universe_sample.name: Bubble Universe
bubble_universe_sample.current_text: An entire universe hanging from a branch of the World Tree, caught before it fell.
bubble_universe_sample.research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

law_crystal.name: Crystallised Law
law_crystal.current_text: A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and froze before it could pop.
law_crystal.research: Hyperdimensional Reality - The space outside every universe, where universes grow on a tree and laws are born from an ocean.

tree_simulacrum.name: Arbor Simulacrum
tree_simulacrum.current_text: A complete simulation of the World Tree, branch by branch, universe by universe.
tree_simulacrum.research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

ocean_simulacrum.name: Primordial Ocean Simulacrum
ocean_simulacrum.current_text: A complete simulation of the Ocean of Laws, still bubbling inside its lattice.
ocean_simulacrum.research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

omnilex.name: Omnilex
omnilex.current_text: Control over every law and every universe. While you carry it, gravity is merely a suggestion.
omnilex.research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

lattice_seed.name: Lattice Seed Crystal
lattice_seed.current_text: A flawless crystal nucleus. Boules grow from it atom by atom.
lattice_seed.research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

topological_boule.research: Topological Matter - Phases of matter protected by topology rather than symmetry.

hyperdimensional_boule.research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

cosmic_lens.name: Cosmic String Lens
cosmic_lens.current_text: A loop of cosmic string bends light into perfect focus. A lithography catalyst.
cosmic_lens.research: The Multiverse - Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.

femto_capacitor.name: Femtoscale Capacitor
femto_capacitor.current_text: A Casimir capacitor smaller than a proton.
femto_capacitor.research: Femtoengineering - Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

femto_transistor.name: Femtoscale Transistor
femto_transistor.research: Femtoengineering - Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

femto_inductor.name: Femtoscale Inductor
femto_inductor.current_text: A superconducting coil wound around nothing.
femto_inductor.research: Femtoengineering - Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

atto_capacitor.name: Attoscale Capacitor
atto_capacitor.current_text: Stores charge in the Higgs field itself.
atto_capacitor.research: Assembly Lines - Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

atto_transistor.name: Attoscale Transistor
atto_transistor.current_text: Switches between superposed states before it is asked to.
atto_transistor.research: Assembly Lines - Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

atto_inductor.name: Attoscale Inductor
atto_inductor.current_text: Wound from a magnetic monopole's field lines.
atto_inductor.research: Assembly Lines - Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

circuit_substrate.name: Metamaterial Substrate
circuit_substrate.current_text: The blank on which every circuit board is built.
circuit_substrate.research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

photonic_board.name: Photonic Circuit Board
photonic_board.research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

topological_board.name: Topological Circuit Board
topological_board.current_text: A board whose traces are protected by topology.
topological_board.research: Assembly Lines - Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

cosmic_board.name: Cosmic Circuit Board
cosmic_board.current_text: A board laid across a Calabi-Yau manifold.
cosmic_board.research: The Multiverse - Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.

photonic_processor.name: Photonic Processor
photonic_processor.current_text: Tier I processor. Computes with light.
photonic_processor.research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

topological_processor.name: Topological Processor
topological_processor.current_text: Tier III processor. Fault-tolerant by geometry.
topological_processor.research: Assembly Lines - Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

hyperdimensional_processor.name: Hyperdimensional Processor
hyperdimensional_processor.current_text: Tier IV processor. Its logic gates take inputs from directions that do not exist.
hyperdimensional_processor.research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

cosmic_processor.name: Cosmic Processor
cosmic_processor.current_text: Tier V processor. A computer the size of a galaxy, folded into a chip.
cosmic_processor.research: The Multiverse - Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.

ontological_processor.name: Ontological Processor
ontological_processor.current_text: Tier VI processor. It does not compute answers - it decides what is true.
ontological_processor.research: The Simulation Hypothesis - If reality is computed, it can be decompiled - and edited.

transfinite_processor.name: Transfinite Processor
transfinite_processor.current_text: Tier VII processor. Finishes infinitely many operations in finite time.
transfinite_processor.research: Incompleteness - Any system strong enough to describe arithmetic contains truths it can never prove - reality included.

higgs_catalyst.name: Higgs Catalyst
higgs_catalyst.current_text: A pinned Higgs-field bubble. Required (not consumed) by mass-altering processes.
higgs_catalyst.research: Mass Manipulation - Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.

spacetime_catalyst.name: Spacetime Catalyst
spacetime_catalyst.current_text: A self-sustaining knot of curved spacetime. Required (not consumed) by hyperdimensional processes.
spacetime_catalyst.research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

eternity_catalyst.name: Eternity Catalyst
eternity_catalyst.current_text: Time flows through it without passing. Required (not consumed) by the final processes.
eternity_catalyst.research: The Simulation Hypothesis - If reality is computed, it can be decompiled - and edited.

chronosteel_ingot.name: Chronosteel Ingot
chronosteel_ingot.current_text: Neutronium forged in a pocket of stopped time. It never ages, rusts or wears.

spacetime_alloy_ingot.name: Spacetime Alloy Ingot
spacetime_alloy_ingot.current_text: An alloy of matter and curved space. Its reflection shows distant stars.

cosmic_neutronium_ingot.name: Cosmic Neutronium Ingot
cosmic_neutronium_ingot.current_text: Neutronium compressed with dark matter in a star's heart. Starlight drifts through it.

spacetime_slag.name: Spacetime Slag
spacetime_slag.current_text: Crumpled leftover geometry. A Maxwell's demon can sort useful shards out of it.
spacetime_slag.research: Fractional Distillation - High-tier processes leave Dimensional Residue. Distil it back into useful matter in the Fractionation Spire.

field_calibrator.name: Field Calibrator
field_calibrator.current_text: Use on a multiblock controller to restore its containment, clear a fault and read out the ideal tuning value.

autonomous_calibrator.name: Autonomous Calibrator
autonomous_calibrator.current_text: Installs into a multiblock controller for good: it follows the drifting tuning and repairs containment by itself, for a 25% power tax.
autonomous_calibrator.research: Superintelligence - A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.

structure_assembler.name: Structure Assembler
structure_assembler.current_text: Use on a multiblock controller to build every missing block from your inventory. Sneak-use to preview what is missing.

fractured_essence.name: Fractured Essence
fractured_essence.current_text: A splinter of reality that broke away from a destabilised creature. It is in several places at once.

void_essence.name: Void Essence
void_essence.current_text: What is left of a Void Wraith: a little pocket of nothing that refuses to be filled.

dipole_winding.name: Dipole Winding
dipole_winding.current_text: Superconducting cable wound into a saddle coil. Its field bends a particle beam into a ring.
dipole_winding.research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

quadrupole_pole_tip.name: Quadrupole Pole Tip
quadrupole_pole_tip.current_text: A hyperbolic pole piece ground to within ten nanometres. Four of them squeeze a beam into focus.
quadrupole_pole_tip.research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

rf_resonator_cell.name: RF Resonator Cell
rf_resonator_cell.current_text: A pill-box cavity of topological superconductor. The standing wave inside kicks each passing bunch forward.
rf_resonator_cell.research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

tachyon_klystron.name: Tachyon Klystron
tachyon_klystron.current_text: A microwave amplifier whose electron beam has been replaced with tachyons. It drives RF cavities from slightly in the future.
tachyon_klystron.research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

cryocooler_unit.name: Cryocooler Unit
cryocooler_unit.current_text: A closed-cycle superfluid refrigerator. Superconductors stop superconducting without one.
cryocooler_unit.research: Cryogenics - Near absolute zero, matter forgets it is many particles. Superfluids and Bose-Einstein condensates.

turbomolecular_rotor.name: Turbomolecular Rotor
turbomolecular_rotor.current_text: Bladed discs spinning at ninety thousand rpm, batting gas molecules out of the beamline one at a time.
turbomolecular_rotor.research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

scintillator_crystal.name: Scintillator Crystal
scintillator_crystal.current_text: Flashes when a particle passes through it. Count the flashes and you know what was made in the collision.
scintillator_crystal.research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

pixel_tracker_module.name: Pixel Tracker Module
pixel_tracker_module.current_text: A qubit-array sensor that records the exact path of every charged particle crossing it.
pixel_tracker_module.research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

plasma_nozzle_tip.name: Plasma Nozzle Tip
plasma_nozzle_tip.current_text: A converging magnetic nozzle that accelerates plasma to a few percent of light speed.
plasma_nozzle_tip.research: Plasma Metallurgy - Alloys forged in stellar plasma: Chronosteel and Exotic Solder. Unlocks the Stellar Plasma Crucible.

gravitic_lens_element.name: Gravitic Lens Element
gravitic_lens_element.current_text: A dark-matter lens trimmed so its Einstein ring falls exactly where you need it.
gravitic_lens_element.research: Singularity Physics - Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.

hawking_absorber_plate.name: Hawking Absorber Plate
hawking_absorber_plate.current_text: Metamaterial tuned to soak up the thermal glow a black hole gives off as it evaporates.
hawking_absorber_plate.research: Singularity Physics - Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.

error_correction_lattice.name: Error-Correction Lattice
error_correction_lattice.current_text: Thousands of physical qubits standing guard over one logical qubit, voting out every error.
error_correction_lattice.research: Femtoengineering - Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

anchor_core.name: Spacetime Anchor Core
anchor_core.current_text: Negative mass pinned inside spacetime alloy. It holds the metric still while everything around it bends.
anchor_core.research: Quantum Gravity - Gravitons and spin foam: spacetime made of quanta. Unlocks the Graviton Condenser.

stabiliser_matrix.name: Dimensional Stabiliser Matrix
stabiliser_matrix.current_text: Compactified dimensions woven tight with quantum strings, so they stay rolled up under load.
stabiliser_matrix.research: String Theory - Every particle is a vibrating string. Unlocks the String Resonance Loom.

causal_shield_lattice.name: Causal Shield Lattice
causal_shield_lattice.current_text: Chronosteel threaded with stored chronons. Paradoxes that hit it are deflected into somebody else's timeline.
causal_shield_lattice.research: Chronodynamics - If time is quantised, its quanta can be stored.
